resolution.question: The two founders of the Tidepool app have been at odds over strategy since spring. Will they announce a buyout of one side to their twelve employees within the next three months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that the founders jointly or individually announce a buyout of one founder's stake to the twelve employees (e.g., via a company-wide meeting, email, or official statement). Resolve NO if no such announcement occurs by the cutoff.
